title: Job Receipt
description: Input contract for the Job Receipt template: the slip a customer gets when the shop receives a repair or a print job, printed on A5 or on a 58/80 mm receipt roll (`paper`). Strings that do not apply are ""; a figure or date that does not apply is null. See the sibling .json for a worked example.

paper.description: A5 sheet or a 58/80 mm receipt roll.

logoUrl.description: Shop logo as an http(s) URL or data: URI; "" for none.

ticketNumber.description: REP-000123 or PRN-000123; the customer quotes it and it is printed as a QR code the till scans.

receivedOn.description: The day the job was received in the shop's own time zone, e.g. 20 Nov 2026.

receivedAt.description: The time the job was received in the shop's own time zone, e.g. 14:35.

title.description: Repair: the device. Print job: the kind of print.

detail.description: Repair: what the customer reported. Print job: the quantity and kind, e.g. 20 × Mug.

serialNumber.description: Serial number or IMEI of the device; "" for none and for print jobs.

itemLines.description: Repair: what the shop plans to do, one line per piece of work. Print job: empty.

estimateCents.description: The estimate in cents; null when nothing is quoted yet.

promisedReadyOn.description: The day the shop promised the job would be ready, e.g. 27 Nov 2026; null when none was agreed.

isWarrantyRework.description: Free work redoing an earlier job under its warranty; the slip says there is no charge.

qrData.description: What the QR code holds: the ticket number.

termsText.description: The shop's terms for received jobs; "" prints none.

uncollectedAfterDays.description: Days after which the shop is no longer responsible for an uncollected job; null prints no warning.
